messages.subject: Project Yarrow - Caldera supply agreement bring-down
messages.plaintextBody:
James - separate point, nothing to do with the employment matter: Caldera's in-house team have come back on the Project Yarrow composite supply agreement and want the liability cap point reconfirmed before their board meeting. Can you ask Elena where we landed on the 135% figure and whether the bring-down certificate has gone out? I think that one's closed but let's be sure.

Sarah
